rows.en:
Don't tell me you're some kind of gourmet?
...How cheeky.
'Gourmet' is a title granted only to handsome men like me.
I'm feeling rather put out now.
You said something far too cheeky, that's why.{p}

...Hm?
Is this a message from your past life?
Maybe your cheekiness is a fact that hasn't changed since your past life.
Hmmm...
A cheeky man...

Maybe you were a prince of some country...
...No, nothing's been settled that clearly yet.
But that might be close...
Even supposing you weren't a prince.
You could've been a prince's aide, or his pet...
Or an ingredient in a dish served at the prince's table...
Those possibilities are all still open.
...You don't believe me?
Right!
Then I'll read your fortune in even more detail☆{p}

There are plenty of people like that, you know.
People who say that kind of thing without understanding the first thing about how wonderful movies are.
...Oh, I'm not saying you're one of them.
I'm speaking in general.
Just in general.{p}

......
...Oh?
Did I put you in a bad mood?
Don't make that face.
As a special treat, just for you, since you chose the Special Course, I'll teach you a marvelous charm.
...Ready?{p}

Sports!
Well now, so you're a sportsman?{p}
You sure don't look like one, though.

Ha ha ha...
If anything, you look like you've got terrible reflexes.
Aren't you just saying that because you want to be popular?
I know all about it.
Well then, for someone like you...
As a special treat, just for you, since you chose the Special Course, I'll teach you a marvelous charm.{p}

Traveling, huh?
You do love that sort of thing, don't you?
...You're out to pick up girls, right?
I know all about it.
No, you don't have to hide it.
I think I've got your personality figured out.
You seem like a simple guy.
The fortune says so too.
Your past life must have been a pretty simple fellow too.
Well, don't let it get you down.
Even if your past life was nothing special, you can just try hard from now on.
Of course, some people never get rewarded however hard they try.
...Why the sulky face?
Did I put you in a gloomy mood?
Then how about I blow that mood away for you?
As a special treat, just for you, since you chose the Special Course, I'll teach you a marvelous charm.{p}

Fwaaah...
Hm!
I've got it.
That yawn just brought an important fact to the surface.
Mmmm...
It's coming to me, it's coming to me.
...{a}, listen carefully to what I'm about to tell you.
Ready?
Now, just for you, since you chose the Special Course, I'll teach you a marvelous charm.
Repeat after me, exactly as I say it.{p}

I see.
Then what is your hobby?
Uh-huh, uh-huh...
...{p}

What?!
Tea ceremony and flower arranging...?
...
Look...
Cut out the bad jokes, will you?
A joke only really works when a gentleman like me tells it, you know.{p}
Watch yourself from now on, okay?{p}

Hmmmmm?
Are you embarrassed?
Go on, just say it.
If those words are hard to say, you can say this instead.
...Use polite language and say it respectfully.
"I have the utmost respect for Kazama."{p}

Just be good and do as I say.
If you do, I'll take care of you personally.
Heh heh heh...
And it's also good to say this:
"I have the utmost respect for Kazama."
If you keep repeating those words, your future is as good as guaranteed.
Go on... say it.{p}

"No way... I wouldn't say that even if you tore my mouth open!"
When I stood my ground...{p}

Kazama got a faraway look in his eyes.
"Please... don't make me so sad.
If you have even a shred of common sense, you'd better do as I say.
...Right?"{p}

Kazama gazed at me with round, innocent eyes.
...Huh?
This guy has kind of cute eyes.

...Whoa!
No, no, no☆
What am I thinking?
The only thing to do with someone like this is ignore him.{p}

"Hmm, I'm gradually beginning to see your past life...
Did you just recite those words in your heart instead of saying them out loud?"
Kazama was muttering something to himself.
...Maybe I'll just ignore him.{p}

...Or so I thought, but suddenly he grinned and started saying this:
"{a}... I can see your past life clearly now.
It's really hard to say, but..."
Kazama wore a nasty smile.
What is with this guy?
He's not going to say something nasty because he's mad I ignored him, is he?{p}

Oh, I see.
You don't want to hear it?
...But you know, {a}.
You mustn't run away.
You must never run away.
You mustn't turn your eyes away from any truth.
That's what being a man is all about.
So, about your past life...
Try to guess it from the following.
Trust your intuition and picture your past life in your head.
Ready?
Now, take your pick{p}

Whoa!
You've got pretty sharp intuition!
Your past life was a sea slug.
Phew, what a relief!
That you guessed it, I mean.
It would've been a bit hard to say that with my own mouth.{p}

........
I'd rather not have had to say this, but...
If you've guessed it, there's nothing for it.
That's right, your past life was a Galapagos lizard.{p}
...Pfft

What are you saying?
Do you really think your past life was something like that?{p}

...Actually, you're exactly right.
You were a sea anemone drifting in swarms in a certain sea.
I even know your name.
You were called Anemone Jack.
You were a really cute sea anemone.
After you died, you became beautiful coral and ended up as the necklace of a queen of a certain country.
You played a starring role, you know.
...That's a lie.
The Anemone Jack part is true, though.
The coral necklace and the starring role are the big lies.
Ha ha ha...
From birth to death, you were just Anemone Jack.

Hahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahaha☆
...Oh, that's hilarious!{p}

That's right.
No matter what anyone says, you were an anaconda!
Scary, huh?
But it sounds strong, so that's nice, isn't it?
What, I'm just saying whatever because it's not my problem?
Anyone who says that gets a knuckle sandwich.
Take that!
Gyahahaha☆
Ahhahahaha...{p}

Ugh☆
Getting it in one try - that's impressive.
That's right, your past life was an American crayfish.
In plain terms, a lobster.{p}

Heh heh heh...
You were a lovely, glossy, delicious-looking lobster.
Good for you.
...No, maybe that's not so good.

Hahahaha☆
Whee-hya hya hya...{p}

Hmmmmm?
What are you talking about?
I read your past life accurately, didn't I?
Just because you didn't like the result, it's not nice to take that attitude.{p}

You can't stay a student forever, you know.
When you go out into the world, that won't fly.
So stop being so rude.
I'm only telling you this for your own good...{p}

Oh, right, right.
We were still in the middle of the guardian spirit talk, weren't we?
I said your guardian spirit seems to be an amazing person, didn't I?
Don't you want to know what kind of guardian spirit you have?
Of course you do.
Shall I tell you?{p}

Your guardian spirit is... me.
A nice guy with a sweet face.
Got it?
And all of us gathered here are your guardian spirits.
You see, a person doesn't necessarily have just one guardian spirit.
Heh heh heh.

Whoa.
What a scary face you're making.
H-hey... don't come near me.
If you stand next to a handsome man like me with a face like that, you'll just end up making me look better.
Is that what you want?
Go on, go over there.
I said go over there.
Get away from me!

"...Whoa☆"
Kazama shoved me away with all his strength.
I'd thought he did nothing but joke around, but he could be this rough too...
...Huh?
When I happened to glance at Kazama's feet, I saw the 10,000-yen bill from earlier lying there.{p}

"You were about to pick up the 10,000 yen I just dropped and steal it, weren't you?
With that greedy glint in your eyes.
Ugh, how sleazy."
...What a terrible misunderstanding.
I'd meant to look angry...
Kazama was glaring at me.
What on earth is with this guy...{p}

"{a}, about that guardian spirit thing from before."
Kazama put the 10,000-yen bill in his pocket and, all smiles again, started talking.
"The truth is, I'm your guardian spirit."
...Hmm.
What on earth is this guy saying?
He's not going to say something weird again to swindle money out of me, is he?{p}

"What's the matter, {a}?
Are you so surprised you can't speak?
I really am your guardian spirit.
...And not just me.
Everyone gathered here is your guardian spirit.
You see, a person doesn't necessarily have just one guardian spirit..."
I decided to let his words go in one ear and out the other.
I nodded along with the odd 'uh-huh,' never once meeting his eyes.
...That settled it.
"Now, say it.
Say, 'I have the utmost respect for Kazama.'
After all, I'm your guardian spirit..."
Kazama kept muttering.
I kept ignoring him.
Everyone else was silent.

"Ha ha ha... Ah, that was fun!
{a}, I just adore you. Heh heh heh."
Kazama looked like he was truly enjoying himself.
Only his laughter rang out loud through the club room...{p}

Oh, fine.
I get it.
I won't tell you, then.
...Just kidding.
You're pretty slow on the uptake, aren't you?
I guess I'll have to spell it out myself.{p}

Your guardian spirit is already here, talking with you.
You get it now, right?
Your guardian spirits are us.
There isn't necessarily just one guardian spirit.
All of us gathered here are your guardian spirits.{p}

...Huh?
What's wrong? Why the scary face?{p}

Nnhaha☆
Getting angry won't work.
You're not scary at all.
Go on, say it.
Say, 'Kazama is wonderful.'
Right, {a}?
Respect me.
I'll treat you right.

Ah-ha-ha-ha.
...Well then, shall we wrap things up?
See you, {a}.
You're fun, you know, because you're so easy to tease.
Let's keep getting along from here on, okay?
Ha ha ha.......
.......{p}

Saying you don't want to be a warty toad is an insult to the noble Warty Toad.
Your past life was a failure because that kind of insensitivity caught up with you and you kept on blundering.
Pay more attention to your attitude.
Understand?{p}

Hmmmm?
Isn't the truth that you couldn't think of a hobby right away, so you just said 'reading' at random?
I'll tell you, you hardly look like the bookish type.

Ha ha ha...
...Hm?
Why are you making that face?
Did I hit a sore spot and make you sad?{p}
